text.en: Hymns Ancient and Modern printed this tune by leave of an earlier publisher. Its 1868 preface lists Dr. Gauntlett's tunes for the book: one new, and "a second, No. 361, harmonized for them, being inserted by leave of Mr. Masters". So the tune was printed before, and the four parts were Gauntlett's own, made for the book.
text.es: Hymns Ancient and Modern imprimió esta melodía con permiso de un editor anterior. Su prefacio de 1868 enumera las melodías del Dr. Gauntlett para el libro: una nueva y "a second, No. 361, harmonized for them, being inserted by leave of Mr. Masters" (una segunda, la n.º 361, armonizada para ellos, incluida con permiso del Sr. Masters). Así que la melodía ya se había impreso antes, y las cuatro voces eran del propio Gauntlett, hechas para el libro.

source.en: Hymns Ancient and Modern, with Accompanying Tunes, with Appendix, under the musical editorship of William Henry Monk (London: printed for the proprietors by W. Clowes and Sons, 1868), preface, p. ix, and No. 361; University of Toronto, Faculty of Music copy, read from the scan
source.es: Hymns Ancient and Modern, with Accompanying Tunes, with Appendix, con William Henry Monk como editor musical (Londres: impreso para los propietarios por W. Clowes and Sons, 1868), prefacio, p. ix, y n.º 361; ejemplar de la University of Toronto, Faculty of Music, leído en el escaneo

text.en: Mrs. Alexander wrote this hymn for children, on a line of the Creed: an American edition of her Hymns for Little Children heads it "Who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary". In its third verse, not sung here, Jesus watches "the lovely maiden"; Hymns Ancient and Modern (1868) prints "the lowly maiden".
text.es: La señora Alexander escribió este himno para niños, sobre una frase del Credo: una edición estadounidense de su Hymns for Little Children lo encabeza con "Who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary" (que fue concebido por obra del Espíritu Santo, nació de la Virgen María). En su tercera estrofa, que aquí no se canta, Jesús cuida a "the lovely maiden" (la hermosa doncella); Hymns Ancient and Modern (1868) imprime "the lowly maiden" (la humilde doncella).

source.en: Cecil Frances Alexander, Hymns for Little Children, First American Edition (Philadelphia: Hooker, [1850]), No. 11, p. 30; and Hymns Ancient and Modern, with Appendix (London: W. Clowes and Sons, 1868), No. 361, the words; read from the scans
source.es: Cecil Frances Alexander, Hymns for Little Children, primera edición estadounidense (Filadelfia: Hooker, [1850]), n.º 11, p. 30; y Hymns Ancient and Modern, with Appendix (Londres: W. Clowes and Sons, 1868), n.º 361, la letra; leído en los escaneos
